title: Epic: Build HTML5 Platformer Game
description: Create a fully playable platformer game with player movement, platforms, gravity, collision detection, and level design. Target: Browser-based using HTML5 Canvas and vanilla JavaScript.

title: Build game engine core with canvas and game loop
description: Create HTML file, canvas setup, game loop with requestAnimationFrame, delta time calculation

title: Add keyboard input handling
description: Capture arrow keys/WASD for movement, spacebar for jump. Track key states (pressed/released)

title: Create player character with movement
description: Player object with position, velocity. Implement left/right movement, jumping, grounded detection, sprite rendering

title: Design platforms and level system
description: Platform data structure, create multiple platforms at different positions, collision detection with platforms

title: Add visual polish and rendering
description: Improve graphics, add colors, background, camera system, sprite improvements, animations

title: Epic: Multiplayer Pac-Man with Colyseus
description: Build a real-time multiplayer Pac-Man game using Colyseus server framework. Support 4 players simultaneously, ghost AI, pellet collection, power-ups, and real-time synchronization.

title: Design Iteration 1: Initial game architecture proposal
description: PROPOSER AGENT: Create initial architectural design for multiplayer Pac-Man. Include: tech stack (Colyseus, Node.js, client framework), game state structure, network sync strategy, file/folder organization, data models for players/ghosts/maze. Be specific and detailed.

title: Design Iteration 1: Critique and feedback
description: CRITIQUE AGENT: Review the initial architecture proposal. Identify: scalability issues, missing components, potential bugs, better alternatives, unclear specifications. Provide specific, actionable feedback. Rate design quality 0-100.

title: Design Iteration 2: Refined proposal addressing feedback
description: PROPOSER AGENT: Revise architecture based on critique feedback. Address all concerns raised. Explain how each issue was resolved. Improve unclear areas.

title: Design Iteration 2: Second critique
description: CRITIQUE AGENT: Review revised design. Check if previous feedback was addressed. Identify any remaining issues or new concerns. Rate improvement. If quality ≥90, approve to proceed.

title: Design Iteration 3: Second refinement (if needed)
description: PROPOSER AGENT: Further refine design if quality <90. Focus on remaining weak points. Add more detail to critical components.

title: Design Iteration 3: Third critique
description: CRITIQUE AGENT: Final detailed review. If quality ≥90, approve. Otherwise, identify critical blockers only.

title: Design Iteration 4: Final design (if needed)
description: PROPOSER AGENT: Address only critical blockers from previous critique. Finalize design document.

title: Design Iteration 4: Final approval
description: CRITIQUE AGENT: Final approval or rejection. Approve if quality ≥80 (compromise after 4 iterations). Document any remaining technical debt.

title: Finalize design documentation
description: ARCHITECT AGENT: Compile approved design into comprehensive DESIGN.md document. Include architecture diagrams, API specifications, data models, file structure.

title: Setup Colyseus server project structure
description: Initialize Node.js project, install Colyseus dependencies, setup TypeScript, create basic server entry point, configure development environment.

title: Implement game room and state management
description: Create GameRoom class, define game state schema (players, ghosts, maze, pellets), implement state synchronization, handle player join/leave.

title: Build maze generation and collision system
description: Create maze data structure, implement wall collision detection, define spawn points for players/ghosts, create pathfinding grid.

title: Implement player movement and input handling
description: Handle player input messages from clients, validate movements, update player positions, implement grid-based movement, handle direction changes.

title: Create ghost AI and pathfinding
description: Implement 4 ghost behaviors (Blinky: chase, Pinky: ambush, Inky: patrol, Clyde: random). Use A* pathfinding. Handle scatter/chase modes.

title: Add pellet collection and scoring
description: Track pellet positions, handle collection events, calculate scores, implement power pellets, handle ghost-eating mechanics, sync score to clients.

title: Setup client project (HTML5 Canvas)
description: Create HTML/CSS structure, setup Canvas rendering, initialize Colyseus client SDK, create connection logic to game room.

title: Implement client-side rendering
description: Render maze walls, draw players with different colors, render ghosts with sprites/colors, show pellets, implement smooth interpolation for movement.

title: Add client input and network communication
description: Capture keyboard input (arrow keys/WASD), send movement commands to server, handle server state updates, implement client-side prediction.

title: Build UI and game HUD
description: Display scores for all players, show lives, render game timer, add ready/waiting lobby, show game over/win screens, add player names.

title: Add sound effects and music
description: Pac-Man eating sounds, ghost sounds, power-up music, death sound, background music, win/lose sounds.

title: Implement power-ups and special mechanics
description: Speed boost power-up, ghost freeze, point multipliers, fruit bonuses. Sync power-up state across clients.

title: Add animations and visual polish
description: Pac-Man mouth animation, ghost movement animation, death animation, pellet collection effects, power-up visual indicators.
